extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions, covering 4 primary categories: concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We curated 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. We then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates (some restrict subject categories).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: We used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We resize videos to 480×720(832) and sample 49 frames at 16fps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Paired reference and target videos sharing the same non-pixel-aligned semantic controls were created using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models and community LoRAs. For evaluation, we evenly sampled 24 semantic conditions from 4 categories (concept, style, motion, camera) in the test subset, with 2 samples each.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: We introduce a semantic-alignment score that measures consistency between the reference and generated videos; we submit each video pair and detailed evaluation rules to Gemini-2.5-pro for automatic scoring.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. Our mitigations include: (i) a research-only release; (ii) default content filters blocking clearly harmful categories (e.g., sexual content, explicit violence, hate symbols).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, leading to VAP may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: VAP-Data was created using visual effects templates from commercial models (vidu, Kling) and community LoRAs. Thus, the dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models. Performance depends on caption quality and on structural similarity between the main subjects: it is stable when caption styles align and subjects are similar, but degrades when descriptions diverge or when subjects differ markedly.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation. VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping, where a reference video and an optional caption steer concept/style/motion/camera. It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
